title: Astrology Forecast Changes After 5 Days
summary: The astrology forecast has changed after 5 days, with Shani going into reverse on July 27. The new forecast suggests that the period from July 27 to December 11 will be beneficial for those born in Mithun, Kark, and Simha rashes. The government has announced a change in the astrological calendar, which will affect the dates of various festivals and events.
